title.romaji: Isekai Yururi Kikou: Kosodate Shinagara Boukensha Shimasu
title.english: Uma viagem por outro mundo: criando os filhos enquanto se aventura
title.japanese: 異世界ゆるり紀行 ～子育てしながら冒険者します～
synonyms: A Journey Through Another World: Raising Kids While Adventuring

information.synopsis: Depois que um deus o mata acidentalmente, Takumi renasce com novas habilidades em uma floresta cheia de monstros, onde ele encontra gêmeos. Eles são doces, adoráveis ​​e super fortes! Conquistado instantaneamente, ele os chama de Alan e Elena, torna-se seu guardião e se junta a uma guilda de aventureiros para sustentar sua nova família. E assim começa sua vida tranquila de aventuras, acompanhando o crescimento de Alan e Elena!

episodes.title: Outro mundo e gêmeos
episodes.overview: Takumi Kayano died due to a mistake made by a god. As an apology, the god sends him to another world and revives him. As Takumi makes his way through this new world, he finds two small children in the forest.

episodes.title: Prazer em conhecê-lo, Joule
episodes.overview: Takumi has gradually gotten used to his new life and the new world. However, there is one thing he is not happy about at all: the limited selection of bread.

episodes.title: Caça aos Monstros!
episodes.overview: Takumi and the twins are invited on an expedition. The three of them try to hold back their powers, but they feel a menacing gaze fixed on them.

episodes.title: Taku fica louco
episodes.overview: The expedition makes its way through the forest, but something seems off. There are far too few monsters appearing. Then Takumi finally discovers the truth behind the eerie gaze.

episodes.title: Nós vamos derrotar os Goblins!
episodes.overview: Takumi and the twins take on a new mission, but the guild members and villagers are unsure if they are up to the task. After a tough battle, Takumi's animal companions evolve and have a surprise in store.

episodes.title: O oceano! É salgado!
episodes.overview: Takumi is confronted by a slave trader who sees Allen and Elena as his merchandise. A guard quickly arrives to resolve the situation. How can Takumi resolve this and set off to the sea with the twins?

episodes.title: Sereias! Dragões!
episodes.overview: Takumi and the children helped the merfolk and were generously rewarded. They head to a small island to finally master water magic, but then they encounter a strange monster.

episodes.title: Caranguejo! Caranguejo!
episodes.overview: Takumi bids farewell to the Azure Palace and continues on his way to Bailey. Along the way, he discovers a dungeon with 30 levels and decides to explore it a bit.

episodes.title: O que é um pai?
episodes.overview: After arriving in Bailey, Takumi first talks with Syl and receives some news and gifts. Then he heads to the Adventurer's Guild, where a great commotion suddenly breaks out.

episodes.title: Espero que possamos fazer amigos...
episodes.overview: Takumi has a conversation with Cedric, the lord of Bailey. Cedric shows particular interest in the food that Takumi has introduced to the land. Cedric's sons also seem enthusiastic.

episodes.title: Vector faz um bom trabalho!
episodes.overview: Takumi has found the trading company that owns the sunken ship. When he returns it, he is introduced to a variety of interesting spices. An idea for a new dish immediately comes to mind!

episodes.title: Bye Bye! Até a próxima!
episodes.overview: Takumi arrives once again at Cedric's place with the twins, and Cedric immediately has a request for him. Next up is a dungeon that they haven't yet completed. What awaits them down there?
